title: Coordinator response (pastes into episode.mechanism_verdict)
description: Ground every pattern_combinations entry in evidence_summary.json's region_groups -- its ui_region and attributes must exactly match (or be a subset of) one region_groups entry. Do not invent a region or an attribute that isn't already listed there; do not combine attributes from page_level_co_occurrence into a named pattern -- page-level-only co-occurrence is a weak signal, not a combination. A pattern_combinations entry has no evidence_pointers of its own, so if `description` makes a visual claim you MUST set visual_claim_unverified: true -- there is no image-sourced-pointer escape hatch here the way there is for the attribute prompt.
